themes.label: Decrees
themes.rationale: The text is a formal resolution passed by the magistrates (kosmoi) and the assembly of the city of Biannos.
themes.quote: ἔδοξεν Βιαννίων τοῖς κόσμοις καὶ τᾶι πόλει

themes.label: Treaties and Agreements
themes.rationale: The inscription records a formal agreement between two cities involving equal citizenship (isopoliteia), tax exemption (ateleia), and a mutual defense pact.
themes.quote: ποιοῦμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς καὶ ἰσοπολίτας καὶ ἀτελεῖς καὶ πολέμω καὶ εἰράνας. καὶ ἐάν τινες ἐπὶ τὰν χώραν τὰν καθιερωμέναν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰν πόλιν ἐπερχόμενοι πολεμῶσιν ἢ ἀφαιρῶνταί τι ὑμῶν, βοαθήσομεν

themes.label: Honorific Inscriptions
themes.rationale: The decree praises the ambassadors for their service and grants them the status of proxenoi (public representatives).
themes.quote: ἐπαινοῦμεν δὲ καὶ τοὺς πρεσβευτὰς Ἡρόδοτον καὶ Μενεκλῆν ἐπὶ τῶι σπεύδειν ὑπὲρ τᾶς πατρίδος ... εἶναι δὲ αὐτοὺς καὶ τους προξένους τᾶς πόλιος

themes.label: Sacred Laws and Rules
themes.rationale: The text recognizes the religious status of Teos as a city consecrated to Dionysus and its right of asylum (asylia).
themes.quote: ἀποδεικνύοντες τὰν πόλιν ὑπὸ τῶν προγόνων ἁμῶν καθιερωμέναν τῶι Διονύσωι καὶ ἄσυλον γεγενημέναν

themes.label: Stele
themes.rationale: The decree specifies that the text is to be inscribed on a stone stele.
themes.quote: ἀναγράψομεν δὲ τό τε πρότερον δόγμα ἐστάλαι λιθίναι

rationale: This is a Hellenistic decree from the Cretan city of Biannos responding to an embassy from Teos. It reaffirms the kinship (syngeneia) between the two cities, recognizes the asylia of Teos as a city sacred to Dionysus, and grants the Teians equal citizenship and military protection. The text includes standard diplomatic formulas, such as the invitation to the Prytaneion and the appointment of proxenoi. The dating is provided by the magistrate Dexios and the month Eleusinios.
